description: Cross-language conformance fixture for #N-disambiguated symbol-path resolution (issue #38). Consumed by tests/test_symbol_resolution_conformance.py (Python offline symbol tree) and tests/csharp/SymbolPathResolverTests.cs (C# Unity-free resolver). A path is a '/'-delimited segment list; a segment is 'name' or 'name#N' where N is the 0-based occurrence among same-named siblings in child order. A non-'#N' segment matches every same-named sibling and recursion unions the results; the final match-list size decides the outcome: 0 -> not_found, 1 -> unique, >1 -> ambiguous.

cases.name: nested unique path resolves to its leaf node
first same-named sibling is selected by #0
second same-named sibling is selected by #1
same-named siblings with no #N are ambiguous
ambiguous ancestor pruned to one branch by a unique descendant
#N on an ancestor segment then descends to the descendant
#N on an ancestor past the last occurrence is not found
non-existent leaf name is not found
#0 on a name with a single occurrence still resolves it
#1 on a name with a single occurrence is not found
